subject.title: beta.11 safe Customer Marketing project refresh

reconciliation.method: Semantic implementation on the current Personal Office integration line. No merge, blind cherry-pick, whole-file source restore, or packaged release input was used.
result: A runtime-derived sourceIdentity binds canonical real path to the authenticated workspace and remains private to the main-process record.
Manifest projectId and legacy_ids are not replacement authority.
A same-source re-import replaces only that source's prior job, artifacts and approvals, including a manifest rename in place.
Preview success or failure that completes after replacement is discarded without restoring stale state or artifacts.
The renderer shows the service-provided import/update message.
reconciliation.excludedDraftBehavior: The external draft's manifest-declared legacy_ids replacement logic was rejected because it could delete unrelated evidence.

securityGate.surface: tenant-scoped local project import, destructive record replacement, asynchronous preview completion, local paths, release metadata
checks: sourceIdentity is derived after fs.realpath and includes workspaceId
canonical path case is preserved so case-sensitive Windows directories do not collide
sourceIdentity is not projected into renderer snapshots
forged projectId and legacyProjectIds from a different source identity cannot remove prior history
same-source replacement preserves unrelated jobs, artifacts and approvals
stale preview success and failure paths re-read the latest record before any write
no IPC, preload, DB/schema, lockfile, secret or package dependency surface changed

resolvedBlockers: added case-only canonical path collision regression
proved rename-in-place with a changed manifest projectId and stable sourceIdentity

verification.evidence: tsconfig.main.json completed with zero errors; Vite transformed 1176 modules. The existing >500 kB renderer chunk advisory remains.
0 errors and 297 warnings, below the maximum of 358.
Exactly seven leased source paths changed. pnpm-lock.yaml, IPC/preload, DB/schema and packaged release directories did not change.
git diff --check passed; production diff contains no conflict markers, credential patterns or legacy_ids authority logic. The only legacyProjectIds occurrence is a negative test fixture.
10 changed indexed symbols and 139 affected processes across seven files; covered by focused tests, full suite, TypeScript, build, lint and independent Socrates review.

Temporary dependency junctions were verified and removed. An ignored four-entry apps/desktop/node_modules/.vite cache generated by Vite was retained in the producer worktree; no tracked file or dependency target changed.

beta11Source.note: The external actor advanced this worktree during R6. Its final bytes and commit were not used as implementation input.

quarantine.note: Read-only; no reset, stash, clean, commit, move, delete or implementation write was performed.

remainingGates: W0 exact-path integration and post-integration verification
Windows install, upgrade and uninstall validation
real signed/notarized macOS x64 and arm64 artifacts and platform checks
approved RC platform run and separate admin promotion
